_comment: Generic, safe defaults shipped with the pack: read-only git inspection and the pack's own deterministic runtime scripts are pre-allowed since they are LOCAL_WRITE at most and fully covered by tests; destructive git operations are explicitly denied by default per .claude/rules/git-safety.md. A target project's own settings.json is never overwritten by the installer (see installer/install.mjs skip-customized behavior) — this file only applies where the target has none yet.
_comment_git_guard: Dev-only branch policy (docs/engineering/git-safety.md): SessionStart installs the guard into <git-common-dir>/git-guard (from the version committed on dev) and points core.hooksPath at it, then states the policy; PreToolUse runs the installed guard (fallback: the working tree) and fails closed (|| exit 2), refusing git/gh commands, GitHub API tools, worktree isolation and remote sessions that would create, switch to or push any branch other than dev. The installed git hooks are the authoritative layer; these are defence in depth for agents.
